description: WebEOC Road Closures is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. This dataset contains the most recent road closure information used in the Main Roads Travel Map ( dataset includes all types of road closures and incidents. Please refer to the attributes 'ClosureTyp' and 'IncidentType' for more details.Road closure type includes:Road closesRoad open with cautionRoad open with specified conditionsIncident type includes:BushfireDetourFloodingPothole / Road Surface DamageSpecial Event. Coverage: Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are WebEoc, traffic. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
